title: A2A-SE Trust Discount Algorithm Registry
description: Append-only registry of approved Trust Discount algorithm URNs. Follows the IANA registry model. Deprecated algorithms are marked but never removed.

registry.name: Linear Volume-Weighted v1
registry.summary: Rho increases linearly with cross-exchange settlement volume, gated by attestation success rate.

registry.name: Step Function v1
registry.summary: Rho increases in discrete steps as federation milestones are reached.

registry.name: Exponential Decay v1
registry.summary: Rho approaches max asymptotically with diminishing returns on additional volume.
